champion.tips: CAMILLE TIPS AND TRICKS In team fights, don’t run directly towards the enemy. The best way to team fight for Camille is by flanking the enemy from the side and then using your Ultimate R on a carry. Before using your E aggressively, check the map to see if the enemy Jungler is nearby. It’s important that you do not engage if they’re nearby. If you’re not able to get any kills in the top lane post 6, you could look to roam and help another lane out with your Ultimate R .
champion.builds: THE BEST CAMILLE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Camille Top build, you should take Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Shield Bash, Bone Plating and Unflinching in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Ravenous Hydra. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 53.7% winrate over 22 457 matches played. Optional Your second option for Camille Top build would be to take Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Shield Bash in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Trinity Force, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Ravenous Hydra as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 53.2% win rate over 3 429 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Shield Bash in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Trinity Force as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Ravenous Hydra as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 53.6% win rate across 1 047 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Camille Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Jack Of All Trades as your primary rune tree, and Shield Bash with Bone Plating as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Trinity Force as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Ravenous Hydra as third item. The last 3 options are Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 60.0% win rate over 100 matches played. Situational Camille Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Camille build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Camille runes page.
